What is SSG? 🌸

SSG (Saline Sonohysterography) is a special ultrasound test where saline is gently used to clearly see the inside of the uterus.

SSG helps detect:
✅ Uterine polyps
✅ Fibroids
✅ Adhesions or scars
✅ Causes of infertility
✅ Causes of recurrent pregnancy loss

A clear and healthy uterine cavity can improve the chances of implantation and pregnancy. Early diagnosis helps your fertility specialist plan the right treatment at the right time. 💛

At Sunrise Fertility & IVF Centre, we provide accurate fertility evaluation and personalized care for every couple’s parenthood journey.

When Should You Get an HSG Test? 🌸

An HSG (Hysterosalpingography) is a simple X-ray test that checks whether your fallopian tubes are open and evaluates the shape of your uterus. It is an important investigation for couples facing difficulty conceiving.

Your doctor may recommend an HSG if:
✅ You have been trying to conceive for 1 year without success (or 6 months if you are over 35)
✅ Pregnancy is not happening despite regular ovulation
✅ You are planning IUI treatment
✅ There is a suspicion of blocked fallopian tubes or unexplained infertility

Blocked fallopian tubes can prevent the egg and sperm from meeting, making natural conception difficult. Identifying the cause early helps your fertility specialist choose the most appropriate treatment.

💛 Early diagnosis leads to better fertility planning and improved chances of pregnancy.

What is Follicular Study? 🌸

Follicular study is a series of ultrasound scans done to track egg growth and identify the right time of ovulation.

It helps in:
✅ Knowing the exact ovulation day
✅ Tracking follicle/egg growth
✅ Timing intercourse or IUI correctly
✅ Improving chances of pregnancy

Right timing can make all the difference when you are trying to conceive. Follicular study helps identify your most fertile days and supports better fertility planning.

At Sunrise Fertility & IVF Centre, we guide couples with accurate monitoring and personalized fertility care. 💛

What is Unexplained Infertility? 🤔🌸

Unexplained infertility means all common fertility reports may look normal, but pregnancy is still not happening.

Common tests may show normal:
✅ Ovulation
✅ Semen analysis
✅ Fallopian tubes
✅ Hormone levels

But sometimes, the cause may be hidden — like egg quality, sperm function, fertilization issues, implantation problems, or mild endometriosis.

The good news is: treatment options are available. 💛
With expert evaluation, personalized planning, and timely treatment, many couples can still achieve pregnancy.

Don’t lose hope. Consult a fertility specialist and take the next step toward parenthood. ✨

Many women struggle to conceive because their fallopian tubes are blocked or damaged.

**Strategies to Improve Egg Quality and Number of Eggs**

Egg quality and egg number are crucial factors for successful conception, whether natural or through IVF. Egg number mainly depends on age and ovarian reserve, while egg quality reflects the genetic and metabolic health of the egg. Although new eggs cannot be created, the quality of existing eggs can be improved by optimizing the body’s internal environment.

A healthy lifestyle forms the foundation of good egg health. A balanced diet rich in proteins, antioxidants, fruits, vegetables, nuts, and healthy fats helps reduce oxidative stress on eggs. Maintaining an ideal body weight, avoiding smoking, alcohol, and excess caffeine, and ensuring adequate sleep are equally important. Stress reduction through yoga, meditation, or regular physical activity supports hormonal balance.

Medical optimization also plays a key role. Treating thyroid disorders, insulin resistance, and hormonal imbalances improves ovulation and ovarian response. Supplements such as CoQ10, myo-inositol, vitamin D, and omega-3 fatty acids may enhance egg quality when taken under medical supervision.

In IVF, individualized stimulation protocols, correct dosing, and precise timing can improve the number of mature eggs retrieved. Ultimately, improving egg quality and number is a gradual process, and early, personalized fertility care offers the best chance of success.
How to Improve Endometrial Thickness:

For pregnancy to occur, the uterus needs a healthy inner lining called the endometrium, where the embryo attaches and grows. In some women, this lining remains thin despite medicines, hormones, or fertility treatments. A thin endometrium can reduce the chances of embryo implantation, especially during IVF.

Mesenchymal Stem Cells (MSCs) are an advanced treatment option for women who do not respond to routine therapies. These special cells have the ability to repair and regenerate damaged tissues. They are usually obtained from safe sources such as the placenta or umbilical cord.

When MSCs are introduced into the uterus, they help improve blood flow, reduce scarring, and promote the growth of healthy endometrial tissue. Unlike treatments that work temporarily, MSC therapy aims to improve the overall quality of the uterine lining.

This therapy may benefit women with very thin endometrium, scarring after infections or surgery, or repeated IVF failures due to poor endometrial growth. MSC therapy is considered a specialized option and is recommended only after proper evaluation and counseling by a fertility specialist.

owner_posts.post_text: IVF healthcare is a coordinated clinical process — ovarian stimulation, egg retrieval under ultrasound guidance, laboratory fertilisation through IVF or ICSI, embryo culture to blastocyst stage, and timed uterine transfer — supported throughout by hormonal monitoring, diagnostic review, and personalised protocol adjustments. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre, an IVF doctor in Mumbai, builds each treatment plan around individual diagnostic findings rather than a generalised fertility protocol.

Research across millions of IVF births shows no significant difference in the cognitive, physical, or psychological development of children conceived through IVF compared to those conceived naturally. Concerns about IVF babies' health persist largely because they are not consistently addressed at the consultation stage. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre, where an IVF doctor in Mumbai, integrates clear, evidence-based health outcome discussions into every patient consultation before any cycle is recommended or initiated.

AMH reflects the quantity of remaining follicles in the ovaries, but its clinical significance depends entirely on the patient's age — a reading of 1.2 ng/mL means something very different at 29 than at 41. Normal reference ranges shift with age: 2.5–5.0 ng/mL at 25–30 years, narrowing to 0.5–2.5 ng/mL between 36 and 40. As an IVF specialist in Mumbai, Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre interprets AMH alongside antral follicle count and prior stimulation response before finalising any fertility treatment approach.

IUI involves processing a semen sample in the laboratory to concentrate motile sperm, then placing them directly into the uterus via a thin catheter timed to coincide with ovulation — eliminating the cervical barrier that filtered sperm must otherwise navigate in natural conception. The procedure takes under 10 minutes and requires no anaesthesia. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre offers IUI Treatment in Mumbai with ovulation monitoring and a full diagnostic workup before any protocol is recommended.

PGT-A screens IVF embryos for chromosomal abnormalities before transfer — identifying which embryos have the correct chromosome count and reducing the risk of failed implantation and miscarriage in high-risk groups. It is most clinically relevant for women over 37, those with recurrent miscarriage, and patients with repeated implantation failure despite good-quality embryos. As an IVF specialist in Mumbai, Saraogi Hospital recommends PGT-A based on case history and failure pattern, not as a routine add-on.

No injection IVF — also referred to as natural or minimal stimulation IVF — relies on the body's own hormonal cycle to develop eggs, either without stimulation medications or with a significantly reduced oral medication protocol. It is suited to select patient profiles where conventional stimulation may not be the most appropriate path. An IVF doctor in Mumbai at Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre evaluates each patient's ovarian response and medical history before recommending this or any other fertility protocol.

AMH levels guide IVF planning but do not set a fixed cutoff for eligibility. A range of 1.0–3.5 ng/mL is considered optimal, yet cycles with AMH below 0.5 ng/mL can still proceed with adjusted stimulation protocols. Age and antral follicle count matter as much as AMH when assessing ovarian reserve. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre and IVF specialist in Mumbai, individualises stimulation plans based on the full fertility profile, not a single marker.

The 30 days before egg retrieval present a clinically meaningful window for improving egg quality through targeted nutrition, supplementation, and lifestyle adjustments. CoQ10 supports mitochondrial function in egg cells, methylfolate addresses absorption in women with MTHFR variants, and Vitamin D deficiency — common and often undetected — is linked to lower fertilisation rates. The IVF doctor in Mumbai at Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre builds pre-cycle preparation around each patient's bloodwork, not a standard supplement list.

ICSI embryo transfer involves injecting a single healthy sperm directly into a mature egg, with 2026 success rates in India ranging 50% to 60% per transfer for women under 35. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre applies blastocyst culture, AI-assisted embryo selection, and ERA-guided timing. Dr. Mohit Saraogi oversees ICSI Treatment in Mumbai for male-factor and unexplained infertility through a patient-first clinical approach.

When trying to conceive naturally, intercourse timed within the fertile window is clinically more significant than daily frequency. Ovulation typically occurs mid-cycle, and the five days preceding it, along with the day of ovulation itself, represent the highest probability of conception. Understanding and tracking this window reduces unnecessary pressure on couples. Fertility guidance on cycle awareness is offered by an infertility specialist in Mumbai. Saraogi Hospital & IRIS IVF Centre also provides IVF, IUI, ICSI, and ovulation induction where needed.
